notes.title: Limit Unleash
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/1030a7cfc2bd61283e992d355dc5eb050aad6d40.png[/img]
[h3]Hi Everyone,[/h3]

In Version 1.1, Limit Unleash Mode is added into the game. Limit Unleash Mode is mainly designed for end game player. You will discover this mode after you reach 60 minutes in Endless Mode.

In Limit Unleash Mode, there are total 9999 levels, each level increase monster’s health, attack, defense and resistance by 100%. Each levels are free to enter without complete previous level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/fa4869a9ea0a1458eabd685ca9e98800d725a894.gif[/img]

Also, this mode will unleash the limit of card drop. In default setting, monster will always drop 1 card after drop rate reach 100%. After you enable the Limit unleash Mode, monster will drop more than one card. For example: When drop rate reach 250%, monster will always drop 2 cards and have 50% chance to drop one more card.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/9c07e562643949e21c54450c9147381ad50dfad7.gif[/img]

Also, there are some modifications and bugs fix come with this version. Please feel free to check it out!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add New Mode: Limit Unleash
[*] Add “Use All Coins” Button for Drop Level Upgrade
[/list]
[h2]Modifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhance performance
[*] Enemy Resistance Increase also increase recovery speed
[*] Decrease drop rate increase rate after drop level reach 1000
[*] Player Health Display will remain 0 after dead
[*] Reduce Ice Stone Effect
[/list]
[h2]Bugs Fix[/h2]

notes.title: Massive Change in Item System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/c5202df15955e3b29ce3e4360157f1bb719b0523.png[/img]
[h3]Hi Everyone,[/h3]

In Version 0.12, there is a massive change in Item System. In the previous version, there were two types of items: Magic Items and Craftable Items. Magic Items were rewards obtained through leveling up, while Craftable Items were created using woods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/02de40952ad3ed27afc8303d6ff861a316d1bf96.png[/img]
Now, a new type of item has been introduced: Artifacts. Artifacts are the most powerful items in the game and have replaced Ability Upgrades found in chests. Currently, some Artifacts are enhanced versions of the old Magic Items, while others are enhanced versions of Ability Upgrades. More Artifacts will be added in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/3dfe0889afdc435885dcf86fd3d29f858a7c026b.png[/img]
Additionally, all Craftable Items have been redesigned. The new Craftable Items focus on increasing different abilities without any special effects. They can be crafted repeatedly and stacked.

Next, there haven't been many changes to Magic Items, but some Magic Items have been redesigned as Artifacts, and some Craftable Items have become Magic Items. As a result, the list of Magic Items will be different from before.

Also, there have been minor adjustments to the abilities of monsters.

This update brings a significant change that directly impacts the core gameplay. Please feel free to check it out, giving some feedback and hope you will enjoy it!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Item Types: Artifacts
[*] Remake Craftable Items
[/list]
[h2]Modifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Modify ability of some Magic Items
[*] Modify ability of some Monsters
[/list]

notes.title: Gravity Mage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/7f71f39f1f276bda2926ceafbb4e8c488c340289.png[/img]

Also, there are some modifications and bugs fix come with this version. Please feel free to check it out!

notes.title: Endless
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/805ba8ace6ea6db200a55e4236deb34642f7eb3e.png[/img]
[h3]Hi Everyone,[/h3]

In Version 0.10, Endless mode is added into the game! This mode is an extension of Hypervariant. You may enable it after complete Level 5 of each Stage. In Endless mode, the game will not end after defeat the Final Boss. New enemies will keep generating and also, the enhancement will keep stacking until you dead!

Next, there are some juice up element added into the game:

The glass and flower will interactive with player and monster.

Boss Card become more visible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/894ed6c279030756ce460e2f7ae0980b827c5be2.gif[/img]

Lastly, there are new series of Achievements for you to challenge. Please feel free to try it out!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add Endless Mode
[*] Add 13 New Achievements
[*] Add Vegetation Effect
[*] Add Effect when Defeat Boss
[*] Enhance Monster Hit Effect
[*] Enhance Monster Card Effect
[*] Player and Monster visible behind trees
[/list]
[h2]Modifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Poison Damage reduced by 25% per second instead of 50%
[*] Reduce generate frequency of Razor
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Hypervariant
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/538dd8fdf7a024107b3bdb9a5f78ca0b9c471eda.png[/img]
[h3]Hi Everyone,[/h3]

In Version 0.7, a new mode: Hypervariant is added into the game! You may enter this mode after collecting all stars in corresponding levels. In Hypervariant Mode, enemies will have a random enhancement every a period of time passes. To against the enhanced enemies, each items will also attach a random ability increase. There will be 5 Hypervariant Levels in each stage.

Next, there is a new system: Monster Cards! In Hypervariant mode, there will have chance dropping a card after killing a monster. The drop rate will be increase when you challenging a higher Hypervariant Level. Each card provide a tiny ability up permanently and those increase are stackable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/4b6e51542ca179d06edbe343910050fa1e3818c2.gif[/img]

In addition, a new character: Card Fighter is added into the game! Card Fighter is a character with Very High Critical Damage.

Also, there is a Little Change on Environment Outlook!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919862/44252bb92e2f8ab34787c398fb57993587b78f38.png[/img]

Lastly, there are some new items and modifications come with this version. Please feel free to check it out!
